items.quote: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
items.claim: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the ark's window and deployed a raven as a mechanism to observe whether the waters had receded.
items.action: opened the window and sent forth the raven
items.object: the window, the raven, the waters
items.mechanism: opening a window and releasing a raven to travel to and fro as an indicator of water levels
